props.gloss_en: and wine from his press -- until when? as long as it is fermenting
it was taught: fermenting wine has no [concern] of exposure
and how long is its fermenting? three days
thus was the custom of R' Yehuda son of R' Ilai: on the eve of the Ninth of Av they would bring him dry bread with salt
and he would sit between the oven and the stove and eat
and drink a jug of water with it
and he would resemble one whose dead lies before him
where they were accustomed to do labour on the Ninth of Av, they do; where accustomed not to, they do not
and everywhere, Torah scholars are idle
RSBG says: a person should always make himself as a Torah scholar
it is taught likewise: RSBG says -- a person should always make himself as a Torah scholar, so that he will fast [feel the fast]
RSBG: whoever eats and drinks on the Ninth of Av -- it is as though he eats and drinks on Yom Kippur
R' Akiva: whoever does labour on the Ninth of Av never sees a sign of blessing
the Sages: whoever does labour on the Ninth of Av and does not mourn for Jerusalem does not see her joy
as it is said: 'Rejoice with Jerusalem and be glad with her, all who love her; rejoice for joy with her, all who mourn for her' (Isa 66:10)
from here they said: whoever mourns for Jerusalem merits and sees her joy
and whoever does not mourn for Jerusalem does not see her joy
it is taught likewise: whoever eats meat and drinks wine on the Ninth of Av -- of him the verse says 'and their iniquities were upon their bones' (Ezek 32:27)
